Ringside Studio
First-time activation

Set up ticket protection.

Create the first ticket key

This creates a random key on your device and copies it to your clipboard. This page does not send it to a server or save it in browser storage.

Use this only before your first tickets are issued. Replacing an existing ticket key can stop printed QR codes and private receipt links from working. For future hosting changes, retain the existing key.

Paste into Netlify

  1. Open your boxing project’s Environment variables and add a variable.
  2. Key/name: RINGSIDE_TICKET_KEY.
  3. Tick Contains secret values.
  4. Select Different value for each deploy context.
  5. Click the Production value box and paste the copied key. It contains 64 letters and numbers. Leave all other contexts blank.
  6. Save the variable. Retain the same key securely for future deployments and handover.

Do not paste the key into chat, email, GitHub or a URL. Once saved, replace the clipboard contents by copying ordinary text.
